UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user account linking Google Auth UID to a family vault and language preference.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

familyId.description: ID of the family vault the user belongs to, or empty if onboarding.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred UI language code (English or Kannada).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was updated.

FamilyAccount.title: FamilyAccount
FamilyAccount.description: Isolated family vault root containing admin ownership, member UIDs, and backup metadata.

familyId.description: Unique identifier for the family document.

familyCode.description: Shareable Family ID code used by members to join.

adminUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the family Admin.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of authenticated member UIDs belonging to this family.

totalDocuments.description: Count of active documents stored in the family vault.

lastBackupAt.description: Optional server timestamp of the last completed cloud backup.

autoBackupEnabled.description: Whether automatic scheduled cloud backup is enabled for the family.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when family was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when family was last updated.

FamilyInvite.title: FamilyInvite
FamilyInvite.description: Exact-match invite lookup document keyed by Family ID code so prospective members can resolve familyId without listing families.

adminUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the family Admin.

active.description: Whether the invite code is currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when invite was created.

FamilyMember.title: FamilyMember
FamilyMember.description: Profile of a family member within an isolated family vault.

name.description: Full name of the family member.

relation.description: Relationship label (e.g., Self, Spouse, Child, Parent).

linkedUserId.description: Linked Firebase Auth UID if this member uses an app login, or empty string.

email.description: Optional email address of the member.

memberUids.description: Denormalized family member UIDs for fast rule-enforced list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when member was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when member was updated.

FamilyDocument.title: FamilyDocument
FamilyDocument.description: Encrypted family document metadata, expiry tracking, and member-level access permissions.

category.description: One of the 12 supported document categories.

memberId.description: ID of the family member this document belongs to.

uploadedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the uploader.

allowedUids.description: Denormalized list of Auth UIDs permitted to read/access this document.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the encrypted/original document in bytes.

storagePath.description: Optional Firebase Cloud Storage object path.

isEncrypted.description: Whether the local/cloud payload is AES-256-GCM encrypted.

isBackedUp.description: Whether the document payload is backed up to cloud storage.

isSample.description: Whether this entry is a synthetic sample document for testing.

issueDateMillis.description: Issue date in epoch milliseconds, or 0 if not set.

expiryDateMillis.description: Expiry date in epoch milliseconds, or 0 if not set.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when document record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when document record was updated.

FamilyVaultSecret.title: FamilyVaultSecret
FamilyVaultSecret.description: Family-scoped 256-bit AES vault encryption key restricted strictly to authenticated family members.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when vault key was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when vault key was updated.

CloudAppConfig.title: CloudAppConfig
CloudAppConfig.description: Global cloud-synced notices, dynamic document categories, configurable labels, and supported settings synced without an APK update.

FamilyCloudConfig.title: FamilyCloudConfig
FamilyCloudConfig.description: Family-scoped cloud-synced notices, custom categories, configurable labels, and supported vault settings editable by the Family Admin without rebuilding the APK.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Global Spark-compatible live cloud content & supported config document (docId = live).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile and family vault pointer.

/families/{familyId}.description: Family vault metadata isolated by memberUids and adminUid.

/family_invites/{familyCode}.description: Single-get invite resolution mapping Family ID code to familyId.

/families/{familyId}/members/{memberId}.description: Family member profiles scoped to the family.

/families/{familyId}/documents/{docId}.description: Family document metadata scoped to permitted UIDs (allowedUids) and family isolation.

/families/{familyId}/secrets/{secretId}.description: Member-only family AES-256 vault encryption key (docId = vault_key).

/families/{familyId}/config/{configId}.description: Admin-managed family cloud config synced to members in real time (docId = live).
